headline: Samsung has new Galaxy headphones in the works
summary: Samsung is reportedly developing new over-ear headphones, dubbed "Galaxy H1." Hints found in the Galaxy Wearable app suggest the upcoming device. Expected to launch in 2027, they could challenge Apple's AirPods Max.

headline: A RAMageddon guide to back-to-school laptop shopping
summary: Laptop prices are currently affected by an ongoing RAM and storage crunch. This makes some affordable models pricier than they used to be. A new guide offers advice for students navigating the market.

headline: Lamborghini’s flagship Revuelto levels up with SV trim
summary: Lamborghini introduces an upgraded SV trim for its flagship Revuelto supercar. The company aims for drivers to become "one with their vehicle" for an immersive experience. This new model focuses on enhancing driver engagement.

headline: The X-Files creator Chris Carter wanted to make a more horrific movie
summary: Chris Carter originally envisioned a more grisly "X-Files: I Want to Believe" film. His intended story focused on faith, the supernatural, and a horrific tone. Executives at 20th Century Fox opted for a different direction for the 2008 movie.

headline: Disney Animation Studios Boss Jared Bush Isn't Ruling Out a Possible Kingdom Hearts Movie
summary: Jared Bush, chief creative officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios, discussed a potential Kingdom Hearts feature film. He did not rule out the idea of adapting the popular game series. This indicates a possibility for the franchise to expand into movies.

headline: First Trailer for Star Wars: Starfighter Shown at D23 — Here's What We Saw
summary: Lucasfilm unveiled the debut trailer for "Star Wars: Starfighter" at the Disney fan event, D23. The new title was showcased during the presentation. Details from the trailer reveal what fans can expect from the game.

headline: X-Men Cast Confirmed to Include Inde Navarette as Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, Maya Boyd as Storm, and More | D23 2026
summary: Marvel Studios confirmed new cast members for its MCU X-Men movie reboot at D23 2026. Inde Navarrette will play Rogue, Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, and Maya Boyd as Storm. A long list of names was announced for the upcoming film.

headline: New Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Shows Doctor Doom Raising an Army of Sentinels
summary: Marvel Studios released a new trailer for "Avengers: Doomsday." The trailer highlights Doctor Doom's true power and his plans. Viewers witness Doctor Doom raising an army of Sentinels.

headline: Tributes paid to Jason Arday after ex-Cambridge professor found dead
summary: Tributes are pouring in for former Cambridge professor Jason Arday, who has tragically died. His family expressed profound shock and grief at their loss. They cited a "campaign of misinformation" as a factor that heavily impacted him.

headline: Temporary ban on disposable BBQs as military deployed to help battle wildfires
summary: A temporary ban on disposable BBQs has been implemented due to extreme conditions. The government warns of a "significant risk to the public" amidst drought and heatwave. Military forces are deployed to assist in battling ongoing wildfires.

headline: Powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake kills at least 38 in Indonesia
summary: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia, resulting in at least 38 fatalities. The quake hit Flores, an island located in eastern Indonesia. A search and rescue operation is actively underway to find survivors.

headline: Heathrow Airport pipe leak causes flood disruption
summary: A pipe leak has caused significant flooding and disruption at Heathrow Airport. Water in the central terminal area is impacting operations. Passengers cannot use roads to access the airport due to the flooding.
